1.title: Officials Search for Answers After Fatal Miami Airport Cargo Plane Crash
1.summary: The cargo plane, operated for Amazon, plowed into a public road and crashed into vehicles, killing five people and disrupting more than 200 flights over Labor Day weekend.

2.title: Armed Ohio man arrested after charging at Democratic candidate for governor
2.summary: The candidate, Amy Acton, was not hurt, but her team said several others were injured as the man tried to "lunge" at her.

3.title: Pilot killed in small plane crash near regional airport in Florida
3.summary: The National Transportation Safety Board has identified the plane as a Mooney M20F aircraft, a four-seater propeller plane.

4.title: Canada’s Retaliatory Tariffs Set to Take Effect as Trump Threatens to Escalate
4.summary: New Canadian levies of up to 50 percent are expected to begin Tuesday, even as Washington warns of a new round of American tariffs.

5.title: In Peru, the Trump Administration Sees the Limits of Its Anti-China Push
5.summary: As Secretary of State Marco Rubio travels this week to Peru, its growing economic ties to China have raised tensions with the U.S., but show no signs of reversing course.

6.title: Palestinian parents fear for children's lives at school as settler attacks grow
6.summary: A headteacher in the occupied West Bank has installed new barbed wire fencing after three pupils were killed this year.
